name: Unwritten Tale: The Guiding Star
source:
"Unwritten Tale: The Guiding Star" is a fantasy visual novel where you're pulled into a fictional world to complete an unwritten tale as the new heroine. Your purpose is to prevent any canon's tragic ending with future Male Leads!

[From [url=https://aoeran-team.itch.io/unwritten-tale-the-guiding-star]itch.io[/url]]
